name: James Tannahill Site Agent
description: Answers questions about James Tannahill, his ventures and platforms, and how to make contact, from the published content of jamestannahill.com. Read-only: it retrieves what the site already says and does not transact, schedule, or send mail.

skills.name: Search the site
skills.description: Search jamestannahill.com across pages, ventures and FAQs, returning ranked matches with their URLs.
examples: What does jamestannahill.com say about applied AI in private equity?
Find anything on this site about exit multiples.

skills.name: Look up a venture
skills.description: List the ventures and platforms James Tannahill founded, leads or advises, or return the full record for one of them: thesis, description, website and on-site page.
examples: What ventures does James Tannahill lead?

skills.name: Answer a pre-engagement question
skills.description: Answer from the published FAQ on value engineering, valuation levers, exit multiples, company fit, applied AI in private equity, and how engagements begin.
examples: What levers actually move valuation before a transaction?
What profile of company is the best fit?

skills.name: Get contact details
skills.description: Return how to reach James Tannahill: the contact form, email addresses, the executive profile PDF, and the machine-readable documents describing him and the site.
examples: How do I get in touch with James Tannahill?
Where can I download his executive profile?
